english.title: Interfere with equipment with intent to avoid payment / fail pay charge imposed by charging scheme
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) interfered with, or interfered with the functioning of, equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), used for or in connection with charging under a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000, with intent to avoid payment of, or being identified as having failed to pay, a charge imposed by that scheme
english.legislation: Contrary to section 173(5)(a) and (8) of the Transport Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant interfered with, or interfered with the functioning of, equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), used for or in connection with charging under a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000, with intent to avoid payment of, or being identified as having failed to pay, a charge imposed by that scheme.
